review.subtitle: Orient Contemporary, black dial, steel bracelet. Front relief GLB, round 1.
notes: Front reference: Orient USA's own product image of this model (the photo supplied was angled); the angled photo and Orient's side image were used for the case and bezel shape.

Modelled: case with a wide sloped polished bezel, faceted applied batons, faceted stick hour and minute hands, polished seconds hand with a paddle counterweight, fluted crown, lugs with a brushed top and polished facet, three-column bracelet.
From the photo map: black dial, minute track, Orient logo and Automatic, movement print, the date disc.
Scale is the listed 40 mm case and 46.1 mm lug to lug. Heights are read from the side image, not measured.
